name: Peripheral 291-Concept Star-Endpoint Control
definition: Use the certified peripheral 291-concept expansion whose active-coordinate reduction is a star, with the stored endpoint orders from the star-transfer verification.
parameters: The contraction has $289$ concepts and the expansion has $291$ concepts.
properties: The unattainable contraction endpoints are exactly $0$ and $256$. The unattainable expansion endpoints are exactly $0,256,4096$, which is the full inverse image of the contraction set. All other $288$ endpoint orders replay, giving a finite control for star endpoint transfer.
